stem: On average, 1 in $75\,000$ adults has a certain genetic disorder.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to find the probability that, in a random sample of $10\,000$ people, at least 1 has the genetic disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
In a random sample of $n$ people, where $n$ is large, the probability that no-one has the genetic disorder is more than 0.9.

Find the largest possible value of $n$.
